title: I Posted the Office Birthday Card That Skipped Only Me

parts.text: They routed a birthday card to every desk on our row except mine, then asked me in the kitchen if I wanted cake. I was twenty-four. I said no thank you and emailed the organizer: I saw the route. She said it was an oversight. The envelope had a checklist. My name was the only one without a tick, in a gap that looked like intention. I printed the checklist, blacked out other names, and left it in her mailbox with a sticky: oversights have patterns. She cried. I did not. The cake was grocery vanilla. I bought a donut downstairs. HR called it a misunderstanding. I called it data. Birthdays are optional. Exclusion as a team sport is not a culture I decorate.

social.video_title: The checklist had a gap shaped like my name — Part 1/1
social.description: Row of desks, one unticked box, grocery vanilla. Would you have eaten the cake anyway?
